test_overview:
Evaluated the ComfortPro Connect Analytics dashboard test plan against the running app on localhost:8000 with the seeded data (Alice, Bob, Tessa; bookings/jobs/invoices A1–D1). Logged in as admin technician Tessa Kim and navigated to the Analytics dashboard via the Analytics nav link. All 6 steps passed with full marks:

1. test_revenue_panel_metrics (25/25): Default filters (This Month/All/All) showed Total Revenue $450.00, Outstanding Total $400.00, Average Job Value $225.00, Revenue by Service Type HVAC $150.00/Plumbing $300.00, Revenue by Booking Type Residential $150.00/Commercial $300.00 — all verified in aria snapshot and screenshot.

2. test_service_type_filter (15/15): Setting Service Type = HVAC updated Total Revenue to $150.00 and kept Outstanding Total at $400.00, confirming snapshot metrics respect the Service Type filter.

3. test_combined_filters (15/15): With HVAC + Residential, Total Revenue = $150.00 and Outstanding Total = $0.00, confirming both filters apply to snapshot metrics.

4. test_filter_reset (5/5): No Reset control exists; manually set Service Type and Booking Type back to All (Time Period stayed This Month). Total Revenue returned to $450.00 and Outstanding Total to $400.00.

5. test_top_clients (15/15): Top Clients table shows Bob Kramer $300.00 / 1 invoice ranked ahead of Alice Ng $150.00 / 1 invoice; invoice counts match the acceptable 'Paid invoices only' implementation; ordered list with Bob first (300 > 150).

6. test_most_requested_categories (15/15): Most Requested section lists Installation, Repair, Maintenance, Emergency each with count 1 (tied counts, order varies — acceptable).

All metrics were verified via the page's aria snapshot and visually confirmed via screenshots. No failures detected; no page reloads or extraneous actions were performed.
